annotation.title_clean: Die Kommission veröffentlicht die Leitlinien zu verbotenen Praktiken der künstlichen Intelligenz (KI) im Sinne des KI-Gesetzes
annotation.title_en: The Commission publishes guidelines on prohibited artificial intelligence (AI) practices under the AI Act
annotation.summary_en: European Commission web page announcing its February 2025 guidelines on prohibited AI practices under the EU AI Act, listing downloads in all EU languages. The guidelines are non-binding interpretive aid for consistent application; authoritative interpretation rests with the CJEU. Covers harmful manipulation, social scoring and real-time remote biometric identification.
key_provisions_or_claims: Guidelines explain AI practices prohibited as unacceptable risk under Regulation (EU) 2024/1689
Addresses harmful manipulation, social scoring and real-time remote biometric identification
Guidelines are non-binding; authoritative interpretation reserved to the CJEU
Aim to ensure uniform and effective application across the EU
Include legal explanations and practical examples for stakeholders
